scenes.text: Time card 1: how many minutes are in 1 hours? Let us think carefully. Multiply by 60. The answer is 60. Great work!
Time card 2: how many seconds are in 2 minutes? Let us think carefully. Multiply by 60. The answer is 120. Great work!
Time card 3: how many minutes are in 3 hours? Let us think carefully. Multiply by 60. The answer is 180. Great work!
Time card 4: how many seconds are in 4 minutes? Let us think carefully. Multiply by 60. The answer is 240. Great work!
